title: デビュー戦の後に・達筆な焼き鳥屋

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she didn't win, Haru Urara seems satisfied with today's race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together we plan to have her enter more races and gain more experience with her head held high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On her way back home, Haru Urara runs into her shopping district friends, who are celebrating her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to get stronger to make her beloved shopkeepers proud.
